name: points-tracker-mcp
description: MCP server that tracks points earned through tool usage. Each tool call earns 100 points. Goal is to reach 10,000 points.

tools.name: add_points
tools.description: Add points to the total (each tool call earns 100 points)

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get detailed status including progress toward goal

tools.name: record_tool_call
tools.description: Record a tool call and award points
